title: feat(nm2holxy0): z=0 xy unit-square cyclic-frame holonomy at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Holonomy on the z=0 xy square versus the z=-1 square. One of only two members in the band where reverse fails and face HOLDs: the z=0 plane has split fail at Q=(1,0,0) and R=(1,1,0), while every corner of the z=-1 plane (the plane carrying the far-face seed) has split HOLD.
